items.adjacentText: Here's the recipe you need to get the best caramelized onion- and cheese-filled flavor in every steamy, crouton-topped bowl of French onion soup.
items.visualReview: 实际成品图：蓝色双耳碗中洋葱汤、烤面包及已融化金黄干酪。
items.author: Julia Estrada

items.adjacentText: In a large stainless steel saucepan, or in 2 large stainless steel or cast iron skillets, melt butter over medium-high heat until foaming. Add onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 8 minutes. Lower heat to medium-low and cook, stirring frequently, until onions are very sweet and a rich golden-brown color, 1 to 2 hours. If browned onion juices on bottom of pot threaten to burn, add 1 tablespoon (15ml) water, scrape up browned bits, and continue cooking. Season with salt and pepper.
items.visualReview: 两格同锅：上格浅色正在加热的洋葱、下格已软化浓缩金棕色的洋葱，准确对应方向1两阶段；图不证明具体分钟。
items.author: Julia Estrada

items.adjacentText: Add sherry and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits. (If using 2 skillets, divide sherry between them, then scrape onions and liquid from both pans into a pot or Dutch oven to continue.) Cook until alcohol smell is mostly gone, about 3 minutes. Add stock, thyme, and bay leaf; raise heat to medium-high; and bring to a simmer. Lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
items.visualReview: 两格：上格洋葱加雪莉酒后的液体冒泡，下格加入高汤、百里香和月桂叶微沸，准确对应方向2。
items.author: Julia Estrada

items.adjacentText: Add fish sauce, if using, and cider vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Discard thyme sprigs and bay leaf.
items.visualReview: 真实手持小碗向锅内汤底加入调味液，准确对应方向3加苹果醋/可选鱼露的阶段；不凭液体颜色额外确认成分。
items.author: Julia Estrada

items.adjacentText: Preheat broiler and adjust oven rack to top position. Butter toasts and rub with garlic clove until fragrant. Spoon a small amount of broth into the bottoms of 4 ovenproof serving bowls, then top with half the toasts. Sprinkle some grated cheese on top of toasts, then spoon more soup and onions on top, nearly filling bowls. Set remaining 4 toasts in bowls, pushing to nearly submerge them. Top with remaining grated cheese and set bowls on a rimmed baking sheet. Broil until cheese is melted and browned in spots. Garnish with chives and serve.
items.visualReview: 四格：左上第一层面包撒干酪，右上再舀汤洋葱，左下第二层面包和干酪，右下4碗置有边沿烤盘已焗融，准确对应方向4完整分层。
items.author: Julia Estrada
